title: Tap into your experiment.
takeaway: A running experiment can feed both an agent and a live view.
proof: A background script replays the burn observations; the agent queries them while a dashboard updates. The same recorded wind readings then drive an illustrative parcel-transport model whose output enters context and the view alongside its inputs.
limits: Recorded observations and a kinematic model, not live physical sensors or a dispersion forecast. Minute-mean horizontal speed is held spatially uniform for each minute; travelled distance integrates speed × 60 s. No mixing, deposition or geographic displacement is inferred. Each stream keeps 18 rows; saved snapshots are versioned; the task stops on completion.
hardest: Keep the original observations visible while wind feeds the model; align model output, live dashboard and retained query to the same source rows.
